name: LitterCaching
shortDescription: Intelligent waste-sorting system — ESP32-CAM + Edge Impulse ML identifies can types and routes them via 3D-printed servo mechanism. Built at MakeUofT 2025.
description:
LitterCaching is an intelligent waste-sorting system. An ESP32-CAM combined with an Edge Impulse ML model identifies different types of cans by sight; once detected, servos and a 3D-printed mechanism sort cans into the appropriate bins to enhance recycling efficiency and accessibility.

Built at MakeUofT 2025 (February 2025).
